summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.34/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.34 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 28, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 27¢ higher than a week ago, 12¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.63 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($4.02) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.59).
